program: Wingless corrective RSI tranche: training-only outcome-mechanism diagnostic
question: Can training-only prequential gain predict the sign and value of future held-out marginal learning better than the static calibrated state signals that failed in R27-R28?
hypothesis: For each of the four sealed manifests and each of the 12 adjacent adaptation-budget intervals, freeze a prequential diagnostic without reading the 582-byte evaluation slice. Let [lo,hi) be the candidate interval in the 872-byte adaptation reservoir and mid=lo+floor((hi-lo)/2). Train LOWER at budget lo and MID at budget mid. Evaluate both models only on the second half of the same adaptation interval [mid,hi), which MID has not seen. PREQUENTIAL_GAIN = exact_hits(MID on [mid,hi)) - exact_hits(LOWER on [mid,hi)); PREQUENTIAL_EFFICIENCY = gain/(hi-mid). After all 12 interval diagnostics for a manifest are frozen, integrate interval gains for each of the same ten 1,744-byte allocation policies and compute predicted policy advantage versus equal. Only then open the sealed evaluation slice and compute actual policy advantage. No fitted coefficient, threshold search, feature selection, or cross-manifest tuning is allowed.

predecessor.eliminated_hypothesis: prediction sign consensus or low ensemble spread is sufficient to identify reliable calibrated policy estimates

cause_effect_trace.observed_failure: static six-signal ridge calibration has large cross-manifest sign errors, and prediction-consensus filters amplify rather than suppress false positives
cause_effect_trace.internal_diagnostic: prequential within-training-stream generalization after a bounded partial update
cause_effect_trace.attributed_cause: static state-change magnitudes may not encode whether a candidate update actually generalizes even one step beyond the bytes that caused it
cause_effect_trace.candidate_corrective_mechanism: measure immediate unseen-within-training-stream predictive gain before allocation outcome labels
cause_effect_trace.frozen_candidate_selection_rule: none; all intervals/policies are evaluated, no threshold is installed
cause_effect_trace.exact_bounded_delta: diagnostic evaluation only; same raw data, capacity, policy set, total allocation budget, no persistent state or authority growth
cause_effect_trace.qualification: deterministic double replay, exact source identities, no evaluation-slice access before policy predictions
cause_effect_trace.held_out_result: sealed 582-byte policy advantages revealed after prequential predictions are frozen
cause_effect_trace.retain_revert: no diagnostic retained as policy in R29; supported mechanism must be prospectively validated on a new disjoint manifest
cause_effect_trace.next_hypothesis: prospective prequential-gated allocator on sixth manifest if supported; otherwise localize outcome mechanism further

frozen_diagnostic.lower_model: same fixed R27 training construction at budget lo
frozen_diagnostic.probe: adaptation reservoir bytes [mid,hi), excluded from MID training
frozen_diagnostic.policy_prediction: sum PREQUENTIAL_GAIN for all complete adjacent intervals whose hi <= policy budget, per arm, summed across arms; advantage subtracts equal policy prediction

policy_metrics.sign_accuracy: sign predicted policy advantage == sign actual held-out policy advantage
policy_metrics.false_positive_reallocation_rate: predicted advantage >0 cases with actual advantage <=0 divided by predicted-positive cases
policy_metrics.rank_concordance: pairwise concordance of predicted vs actual policy advantage within each manifest, averaged across manifests

classification_rules.supported: valid and policy sign accuracy >=0.70, false-positive reallocation rate <=0.30, mean absolute error < R28 ungated 9.219594413938847, and mean rank concordance >=0.65
classification_rules.mixed: valid and at least two of four fixed criteria improve: sign accuracy >0.55; false-positive reallocation rate <0.5384615384615384; mean absolute error <9.219594413938847; mean rank concordance >0.50, while supported thresholds are not all met
classification_rules.negative: valid and fewer than two of those four fixed improvement criteria are met
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, manifest identity, interval split, probe leakage, training construction, policy integration, evaluation ordering, deterministic replay, capacity, provenance or accounting requirement fails

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not change manifests, interval grids, midpoint rule, probe region, model construction, policy set, equal baseline, metrics, thresholds, classification or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: freeze the prequential policy rule before a sixth disjoint manifest and test whether it beats equal under identical budgets

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: factor domain/locality and learning-curve shape without installing a policy

metric_semantics.sign_accuracy: exact sign(predicted policy advantage) equals exact sign(actual policy advantage); zero matches only zero
metric_semantics.false_positive_reallocation_rate: predicted advantage >0 cases with actual advantage <=0 divided by predicted-positive cases; zero if no predicted-positive cases
metric_semantics.mean_absolute_error: mean abs(predicted advantage-actual advantage) over all 40 policy cases
metric_semantics.rank_concordance: within each manifest, over unordered policy pairs with unequal actual advantages: 1 for matching predicted ordering, 0.5 for predicted tie, 0 otherwise; report mean of the four manifest concordances
